note: Selected official OpenAPI contract evidence. Synthetic responses are constructed independently in ExecChecks.

AttachStdin.description: Attach to `stdin` of the exec command.

AttachStdout.description: Attach to `stdout` of the exec command.

AttachStderr.description: Attach to `stderr` of the exec command.

DetachKeys.description:
Override the key sequence for detaching a container. Format is
a single character `[a-Z]` or `ctrl-<value>` where `<value>`
is one of: `a-z`, `@`, `^`, `[`, `,` or `_`.

Env.description: A list of environment variables in the form `["VAR=value", ...]`.

Cmd.description: Command to run, as a string or array of strings.

Privileged.description: Runs the exec process with extended privileges.

User.description:
The user, and optionally, group to run the exec process inside
the container. Format is one of: `user`, `user:group`, `uid`,
or `uid:gid`.

WorkingDir.description: The working directory for the exec process inside the container.

creationResponse.description: Response to an API call that returns just an Id

Id.description: The id of the newly created object.

Pid.description: The system process ID for the exec process.
